propositions: The audit page renderer at line 329 currently checks only for kind == 'operator-attested' when computing the lacking flag, but must also accept kind == 'non-codebase'

827 existing COMPLETION_VERDICT events with kind 'operator-attested' are immutable and must be recognized as un-attested before S5 verifier changes, or the audit page will silently stop flagging un-attested criteria on old records
The kind field is the only site in the codebase performing criterion kind comparison and is currently an unconstrained string with no enum validation
A criterion with kind 'operator-attested' and met false must render with lacking true
A criterion with kind 'non-codebase' and met false must render with lacking true
A criterion with kind 'codebase-verifiable' must be unaffected regardless of met state
